en.title: JSON Comparison Tools
en.description: Compare and diff JSON data to find differences. All processing happens in your browser.
en.pdesc: Compare JSON documents and highlight differences — all locally in your browser.

highlights.title: Side-by-Side Comparison
highlights.description: Compare two JSON documents and see differences highlighted instantly.

highlights.title: Private & Secure
highlights.description: All comparison happens in your browser. No data is uploaded.

faq.q: What types of differences can it find?
faq.a: It can find added keys, removed keys, changed values, and type differences between two JSON documents.
Yes. All comparison happens in your browser. No data is uploaded.

faq.q: Can I compare large JSON files?
faq.a: Yes. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

zh.title: JSON 比较工具
zh.description: 比较和差异分析 JSON 数据。所有处理在浏览器中完成。
zh.pdesc: 比较 JSON 文档并高亮差异 — 全部在浏览器本地完成。

highlights.title: 并排比较
highlights.description: 比较两个 JSON 文档，即时高亮差异。

highlights.title: 私密安全
highlights.description: 所有比较在浏览器中完成，不会上传数据。

faq.q: 能发现哪些类型的差异？
faq.a: 能发现新增的键、删除的键、值的变化以及两个 JSON 文档之间的类型差异。
安全。所有比较在浏览器中完成，不会上传数据。

faq.q: 可以比较大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.a: 可以。所有处理在本地完成，文件大小仅受浏览器内存限制。
